title: "Exercise - Analysis in Quarto"
author: "Joanne D'Souza"

I will be finding the total number of genes in the forebrain for a human, pig and mouse which show reginally elevated levels of expression compared with the rest of the brain. 


```{r}
x <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(paste("For a human brain, the total number of genes showing regionally elevated expression is:", x))

y <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(paste("For a pig brain, the total number of genes showing regionally elevated expression is:", y))

z <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("For a mouse brain, the total number of genes showing regionally elevated expression is:", z))
```

Hence, the specie with the greatest regionally elevated expression in the forebrain are humans. 

```{r}
# This code calculates the sum of two numbers
1 + 9
```
